rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a school headteacher, including a woman.

example.english: The headmistress of that school really cares about the students.
example.traditional: 嗰間學校嘅校長好關心學生。
example.jyutping: go2 gaan1 hok6 haau6 ge3 haau6 zoeng2 hou2 gwaan1 sam1 hok6 saang1

rows.note: Use this when you specifically want to make clear that the headteacher is female.

example.english: The new headmistress will meet with the parents next month.
example.traditional: 新嚟嗰位女校長下個月會同家長見面。
example.jyutping: san1 lai4 go2 wai6 neoi5 haau6 zoeng2 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 tung4 gaa1 zoeng2 gin3 min6
